TRANSMUTER-CRACKED_ALEMBIC.title: Cracked Alembic
TRANSMUTER-CRACKED_ALEMBIC.description: At the start of combat, apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Mercury[/gold] to a random enemy. The first [gold]Reaction[/gold] you trigger each combat grants {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and draws [blue]1[/blue] card.
TRANSMUTER-CRACKED_ALEMBIC.flavor: Even fractured glass remembers the heat of the first distillation.
TRANSMUTER-OUROBOROS_RING.title: Ouroboros Ring
TRANSMUTER-OUROBOROS_RING.description: Whenever an enemy dies while it has any [gold]Reagents[/gold], transfer those [gold]Reagents[/gold] to a random living enemy.
TRANSMUTER-OUROBOROS_RING.flavor: The serpent devours its tail; nothing in the vessel is ever truly lost.
TRANSMUTER-PARACELSUS_SCALPEL.title: Paracelsus's Scalpel
TRANSMUTER-PARACELSUS_SCALPEL.descriptio: [gold]Reactions[/gold] leave [blue]1[/blue] stack of the first reacting [gold]Reagent[/gold] behind instead of consuming all stacks.
TRANSMUTER-PARACELSUS_SCALPEL.flavor: The dose alone makes the poison—and the remnant makes the catalyst.
